cards.audioText: B: Your callsign is CCA 983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, level 9800 meters, SABEN 45, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 983，从 Los Angeles 到 Beijing，DABMA 30，保持 9800 米，SABEN 45，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, maintaining 9800 metres, SABEM 45.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 983，从 Los Angeles 到 Beijing，DABMA 30，保持 9800 米，SABEM 45。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, Beijing Control, confirm squawk 1230.
B: Your squawk is 1232.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，北京管制，确认应答机 1230。
B: 你的应答机是 1232。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 983, squawk 1232, radar contact.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 983，应答机 1232，雷达识别。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing severe turbulence, request descend to low level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 983, we are experiencing severe turbulence, request descend to low level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 983，我们正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 983, roger, descend to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 983，收到，下降到 8400 米。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, what is the detailed ride condition?
B: Tell the ATC, the turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，详细颠簸情况如何？
B: 告诉 ATC，颠簸由积雨云造成。
cards.referenceText: There are severe large CB in the air, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空中有严重的大型 CB，CCA 983。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, roger, thanks.
B: Report to the controller that you have been struck by lightning.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，收到，谢谢。
B: 向管制员报告你们被雷击。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 983, we have been struck by lightning.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, roger, confirm your operations are normal?
B: Tell the controller that flight is smooth, but the main power doesn't work, now you are using the auxiliary power supply.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，收到，确认你们运行正常吗？
B: 告诉管制员飞行平稳，但主电源不工作，现在使用辅助电源。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 983, flight is smooth, but the main power doesn't work, we are using the auxiliary power supply now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 983，飞行平稳，但主电源不工作，我们现在使用辅助电源。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, roger, any other problem?
B: There is something wrong with the navigation system, ask ATC to monitor you closely.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，收到，还有其他问题吗？
B: 导航系统有问题，请 ATC 密切监控你。
cards.referenceText: Our navigation system is out of action, please keep a close eye on us, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的导航系统失效，请密切监控我们，CCA 983。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, roger, where did the lightning strike you?
B: Only the left hand windshield was struck, others are all normal.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，收到，雷击击中哪里？
B: 只有左侧风挡被击中，其他都正常。
cards.referenceText: Lightning hit us above the left hand windshield, 0 damage, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击击中我们左侧风挡上方，无损伤，CCA 983。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, roger, say intention.
B: Request priority landing at Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，收到，说明意图。
B: 请求在 Beijing airport 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing at Beijing airport, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在 Beijing airport 优先着陆，CCA 983。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 983, roger, turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, expect Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 983，收到，左转直飞 HUR，下降并保持 3600 米，预计跑道 01。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, expect Runway 01, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 HUR，下降并保持 3600 米，预计跑道 01，CCA 983。

cards.audioText: B: You want to know weather condition at Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你想了解 Beijing airport 天气情况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 983, advice weather at Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 983，请告知 Beijing airport 天气。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 983, weather is clearing except for a little ice on the runway, expect a visual approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 983，天气正在转好，跑道上除少量结冰外无其他情况，预计目视进近跑道 01。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect visual approach Runway 01, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计目视进近跑道 01，CCA 983。

cards.audioText: B: As a passenger was bruised on the head during the turbulence, request medical service on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 由于一名旅客在颠簸中头部擦伤，请求到达时提供医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: Request medical service on arrival as a passenger was hurt during the turbulence, CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于一名旅客在颠簸中受伤，请求到达时提供医疗服务，CCA 983。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, medical services will be ready on arrival.
B: You have established localizer, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，到达时医疗服务会准备好。
B: 你已建立航向道，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 983, established localizer Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 983，已建立跑道 01 航向道。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 983, cleared to land Runway 01, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, use caution.
B: Read back and ask the Tower whether the preceding aircraft can land normally.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 983，跑道 01 可以着陆，跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，注意。
B: 复诵并询问 塔台 前机是否能正常着陆。
cards.referenceText: runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, did the preceding aircraft land normally? CCA 983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状结冰，刹车效应差，前机是否正常着陆？CCA 983。

cards.audioText: C: All preceding aircraft had normal landings, standing ice is not that serious.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 所有前机均正常着陆，积冰没有那么严重。
